values.note: $25 a night without electric, electric $35 (June 2027). Off-peak $21/$31 (November 2026, January 2027). Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details facilities 492 and 493, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 25.00, Campsite Electric 35.00, Fee 6.50), 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-12 (21.00 / 31.00), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup 50 on all 43 listed electric sites; no water or sewer hookup attribute on any site), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 46 electric and 143 non-electric per ODNR; ReserveOhio lists 43 and 137 online, 32 of those non-electric marked tent-only. Electric pads are 20-50 ft, two of them under 23 ft. Only four non-electric sites post a pad length (24-40 ft); the rest post none. Two pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-hope-state-park-campground ('46 electric sites', '143 non-electric sites') + ReserveOhio search/details for all listed units (Pad Length, IsRVSite, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-hope-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio search/details (MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Heated shower houses; most sites are nearest pit latrines. The camp store is on the cabin peninsula.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-hope-state-park-campground ('Heated showerhouses, flush toilets, pit latrines, waste disposal, and laundry facilities'; 'the peninsula where the camp store is located') + ReserveOhio Restroom Type (Pit on nearly all sites), read 2026-10-31

summary: $25/$35 confirmed; 50-amp, no water or sewer at sites; 189 sites per ODNR; showers, laundry, dump; pin 2.1 km off; lakeview looks unsupported (down lead); season left alone.
flags: PIN: stored 39.3300,-82.3500 is a rounded placeholder down by the lake, ~2.1 km from the site centroid and ~1.1 km from the nearest site (#001, 39.3369,-82.3413). Corrected: 39.3486,-82.3435.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (down): stored lakeview. ReserveOhio's per-site positions run 39.3369-39.3562 along a forest road; the nearest, #001, is ~500 m from the marshy head of the lake (about 39.3366,-82.3474) with full canopy between. ODNR describes 'a scenic, shady wooded area' and doesn't mention a lake view. Positions may be hand-placed; leaf-off imagery wasn't checked.

FIT: the $25 base rests on four non-electric sites with posted pads (#001 24 ft; #178-180 40 ft) plus 101 others typed RV with no length. 32 non-electric sites in 492 are tent-only ('IsRVSite' false). Electric sites are the sure fit at $35 (41 of 43 at 23 ft or more).

SEASON left unset: ODNR says nothing. ReserveOhio had every site open 11/10/2026, and on 1/12/2027 only 38 units in sites 1-49/177-189 (3 electric, 35 non-electric) open, facility 493 closed. That suggests year-round on part of the campground, but it isn't a statement.
PHONE missing: ODNR campground page gives (740) 596-4020.

NO SPLIT: facility 492 (sites 1-49, 148-192) and 493 (50-147) centre 1.3 km apart but read as one campground strung along one road on imagery; no separate entrance seen. Nothing on ODNR's text about a closure; its alert banner loads by script and wasn't read.
